_comment: Curated metadata for update.py. Google Scholar gives titles, years and citation
counts but its venue strings and links are messy, so anything presentational
lives here and wins over the scraped value.
Keys are the paper title, lowercased, with every non-alphanumeric character
removed (update.py normalises the same way). Fields, all optional:
title   - display title, overriding Scholar's inconsistent capitalisation
venue   - short label shown in the card badge
kind    - journal | conference | thesis | preprint (drives the badge colour)
note    - full venue line printed at the bottom of the card
code    - repository link, appended to the footer
tags    - filter chips: rl, security, kg (the year tag is added automatically)
year    - override Scholar's year (it lags behind acceptance)
hide    - true to keep a Scholar entry off the site entirely
